records.context: Publication panels for laboratory microplate assays: statistics, drawing, saving and figures.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#0
records.source: Publication panels for plate assays: statistics, drawing, saving and figures.
records.translation: 플레이트 분석을 위한 출판용 패널: 통계, 그리기, 저장 및 그림.

records.context: Used by :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment` and :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_replication` (``panels`` / ``figures`` settings), and usable on any table with one row per object.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#1
records.source: Used by :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment` and :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_replication` (``panels`` / ``figures`` settings), and usable on any table with one row per object.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment` 와 :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_replication` 에서 (``panels`` / ``figures`` 설정으로) 사용되며, 객체당 한 행인 어떤 표에도 사용할 수 있습니다.

records.context: **Experimental unit.** Objects are averaged per microplate sample position (``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``), and microplate sample position means are averaged per replicate when a replicate column is given (:func:`aggregate_to_unit`). Tests run on these unit values, never on individual cells, so the n of a test is the number of microplate sample positions or replicates.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#2
records.source: **Experimental unit.** Objects are averaged per well (``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``), and well means are averaged per replicate when a replicate column is given (:func:`aggregate_to_unit`). Tests run on these unit values, never on individual cells, so the n of a test is the number of wells or replicates.
records.translation: **실험 단위.** 객체 값은 웰(``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``)별로 평균되고, 반복 열이 주어지면 웰 평균이 다시 반복별로 평균됩니다(:func:`aggregate_to_unit`). 검정은 개별 세포가 아니라 항상 이 단위 값에 대해 수행되므로, 검정의 n 은 웰 또는 반복의 수입니다.

records.context: **Test selection for bar panels** (:func:`select_and_run_test`, one test per panel):
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#3
records.source: **Test selection for bar panels** (:func:`select_and_run_test`, one test per panel):
records.translation: **막대 패널의 검정 선택** (:func:`select_and_run_test`, 패널당 검정 하나):

records.context: Shapiro-Wilk normality per group (groups with fewer than 3 values or no spread count as normal) and Levene equal variance (median centred, the Brown-Forsythe variant);
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#4
records.source: Shapiro-Wilk normality per group (groups with fewer than 3 values or no spread count as normal) and Levene equal variance (median centred, the Brown-Forsythe variant);
records.translation: 그룹별 Shapiro-Wilk 정규성 검정(값이 3개 미만이거나 퍼짐이 없는 그룹은 정규로 간주)과 Levene 등분산 검정(중앙값 중심, Brown-Forsythe 변형);

records.context: every group normal and equal variance: one-way ANOVA, post hoc Tukey HSD;
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#5
records.source: every group normal and equal variance: one-way ANOVA, post hoc Tukey HSD;
records.translation: 모든 그룹이 정규이고 등분산: 일원 ANOVA, 사후 검정 Tukey HSD;

records.context: every group normal, unequal variance: Welch ANOVA, post hoc Games-Howell;
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#6
records.source: every group normal, unequal variance: Welch ANOVA, post hoc Games-Howell;
records.translation: 모든 그룹이 정규이고 이분산: Welch ANOVA, 사후 검정 Games-Howell;

records.context: any group non-normal: Kruskal-Wallis, post hoc Dunn test with Holm correction.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#7
records.source: any group non-normal: Kruskal-Wallis, post hoc Dunn test with Holm correction.
records.translation: 정규가 아닌 그룹이 하나라도 있으면: Kruskal-Wallis, 사후 검정 Holm 보정을 적용한 Dunn 검정.

records.context: **Proportion panels** (:func:`proportion_tests`): object counts per bin, pooled over replicates, compared with a chi-square test of independence or the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo over tables with the observed margins; the Fisher exact test for a 2 x 2 table). The omnibus test covers every group; each group is also compared with the reference group (Holm correction). Cramer V is the effect size. These tests treat every object as independent, so with thousands of objects they flag small shifts; the replicate-level bar panel drawn next to them is the conservative test.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#8
records.source: **Proportion panels** (:func:`proportion_tests`): object counts per bin, pooled over replicates, compared with a chi-square test of independence or the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo over tables with the observed margins; the Fisher exact test for a 2 x 2 table). The omnibus test covers every group; each group is also compared with the reference group (Holm correction). Cramer V is the effect size. These tests treat every object as independent, so with thousands of objects they flag small shifts; the replicate-level bar panel drawn next to them is the conservative test.
records.translation: **비율 패널** (:func:`proportion_tests`): 구간별 객체 수를 반복에 걸쳐 합산하여 카이제곱 독립성 검정 또는 Fisher-Freeman-Halton 정확 검정(관측된 주변합을 가진 표에 대한 Monte Carlo, 2 x 2 표에는 Fisher 정확 검정)으로 비교합니다. 총괄 검정은 모든 그룹을 포함하며, 각 그룹은 기준 그룹과도 비교됩니다(Holm 보정). 효과 크기는 Cramer V 입니다. 이 검정들은 모든 객체를 독립으로 취급하므로 객체가 수천 개이면 작은 변화도 유의하게 표시합니다. 그 옆에 그려지는 반복 수준의 막대 패널이 보수적인 검정입니다.

records.context: **Panel layout on disk** (:func:`save_panel`): one folder per panel, ``<out_dir>/<Pnn>_<name>/`` holding ``<Pnn>_<name>.pdf`` and ``.png``, ``data_replicates.csv`` (the plotted unit values), ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv`` for bar panels, and ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` for stacked panels.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#9
records.source: **Panel layout on disk** (:func:`save_panel`): one folder per panel, ``<out_dir>/<Pnn>_<name>/`` holding ``<Pnn>_<name>.pdf`` and ``.png``, ``data_replicates.csv`` (the plotted unit values), ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv`` for bar panels, and ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` for stacked panels.
records.translation: **디스크의 패널 구성** (:func:`save_panel`): 패널마다 폴더 하나이며, ``<out_dir>/<Pnn>_<name>/`` 에 ``<Pnn>_<name>.pdf`` 와 ``.png``, ``data_replicates.csv`` (그래프에 그린 단위 값), 막대 패널의 경우 ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` 및 ``stats_descriptive.csv``, 누적 패널의 경우 ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` 가 들어 있습니다.

records.context: **Aligned order.** Every panel takes ``order`` (the x-axis order) from :func:`condition_order`, so a condition sits at the same place in every panel of a figure, and ``labels`` (raw value -> display label; underscores become spaces when no label is given). ``annotations`` draws aligned text rows under the x axis, for example a +/- table of what each condition contains.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#10
records.source: **Aligned order.** Every panel takes ``order`` (the x-axis order) from :func:`condition_order`, so a condition sits at the same place in every panel of a figure, and ``labels`` (raw value -> display label; underscores become spaces when no label is given). ``annotations`` draws aligned text rows under the x axis, for example a +/- table of what each condition contains.
records.translation: **정렬된 순서.** 모든 패널은 ``order`` (x축 순서)를 :func:`condition_order` 에서 받으므로 한 그림의 모든 패널에서 조건이 같은 위치에 놓이며, ``labels`` (원시 값 -> 표시 레이블, 레이블이 없으면 밑줄이 공백으로 바뀜)도 받습니다. ``annotations`` 는 x축 아래에 정렬된 텍스트 행을 그립니다. 예를 들어 각 조건에 무엇이 들어 있는지 보여 주는 +/- 표입니다.

records.context: Pure functions plus matplotlib; nothing here opens a window.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#11
records.source: Pure functions plus matplotlib; nothing here opens a window.
records.translation: 순수 함수와 matplotlib 만 사용하며, 여기서는 어떤 창도 열지 않습니다.

records.context: Average object values to the experimental unit.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels.aggregate_to_unit#0
records.source: Average object values to the experimental unit.
records.translation: 객체 값을 실험 단위로 평균합니다.

records.context: Objects -> microplate sample position mean (per ``keys`` + ``well_keys``) -> replicate mean of the microplate sample position means (per ``keys`` + ``replicate_column``) when ``replicate_column`` is given; otherwise the unit is the microplate sample position.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels.aggregate_to_unit#1
records.source: Objects -> well mean (per ``keys`` + ``well_keys``) -> replicate mean of the well means (per ``keys`` + ``replicate_column``) when ``replicate_column`` is given; otherwise the unit is the well.
records.translation: 객체 -> 웰 평균(``keys`` + ``well_keys`` 별) -> 웰 평균의 반복 평균(``keys`` + ``replicate_column`` 별)으로 계산하며, 이는 ``replicate_column`` 이 주어진 경우입니다. 그렇지 않으면 단위는 웰입니다.

records.context: column name or list of column names to average.

records.source: column name or list of column names to average.
records.translation: 평균할 열 이름 또는 열 이름 목록입니다.

records.source: grouping columns kept in the output (e.g. the panel group).

records.context: one row per unit with ``keys``, the unit columns, the averaged ``value`` column(s), ``n_objects`` and (replicate unit) ``n_wells``.

records.source: one row per unit with ``keys``, the unit columns, the averaged ``value`` column(s), ``n_objects`` and (replicate unit) ``n_wells``.
records.translation: 단위당 한 행으로, ``keys``, 단위 열, 평균한 ``value`` 열, ``n_objects`` 및 (반복 단위인 경우) ``n_wells`` 를 가집니다.

records.context: Values listed in ``preferred`` come first, in the order given (entries not present in ``values`` are skipped); the remaining values follow, sorted naturally (``r2`` before ``r10``). Missing values are dropped. Using the same ``preferred`` list for every panel keeps the conditions aligned.

Missing values are dropped. Using the same ``preferred`` list for every panel keeps the conditions aligned.

records.context: Publication panels and extra filters (all opt-in; leaving them at their defaults keeps the output above unchanged):

records.translation: 출판용 패널과 추가 필터(모두 선택 사항이며, 기본값으로 두면 위의 출력은 바뀌지 않습니다):

records.context: ``panels`` — list of key-value mappings, one bar panel each: ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group': column, 'order': list, 'labels': dict, 'annotations': {row: {group value: text}}, 'value': 'recruitment' or any numeric column, 'ymin', 'title', 'ylabel'}``. ``group`` may be any annotated column (``host_cells``, ``pathogen``, ``treatment``, ``condition``, or a column of your own). Ratio values are drawn from y = 1 when every unit value is at least 1. Panel ``i`` is saved as ``results/panels/Pnn_<name>/`` with ``<Pnn_name>.pdf/.png``, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv``. The test is chosen per panel (one-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD, Welch ANOVA + Games-Howell, or Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn test); see :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment#20
records.source: ``panels`` — list of dicts, one bar panel each: ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group': column, 'order': list, 'labels': dict, 'annotations': {row: {group value: text}}, 'value': 'recruitment' or any numeric column, 'ymin', 'title', 'ylabel'}``. ``group`` may be any annotated column (``host_cells``, ``pathogen``, ``treatment``, ``condition``, or a column of your own). Ratio values are drawn from y = 1 when every unit value is at least 1. Panel ``i`` is saved as ``results/panels/Pnn_<name>/`` with ``<Pnn_name>.pdf/.png``, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv``. The test is chosen per panel (one-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD, Welch ANOVA + Games-Howell, or Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn test); see :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`.
records.translation: ``panels`` — 사전 목록으로, 각각 막대 패널 하나입니다: ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group': column, 'order': list, 'labels': dict, 'annotations': {row: {group value: text}}, 'value': 'recruitment' or any numeric column, 'ymin', 'title', 'ylabel'}``. ``group`` 은 주석이 달린 어떤 열이든 될 수 있습니다(``host_cells``, ``pathogen``, ``treatment``, ``condition`` 또는 직접 만든 열). 모든 단위 값이 1 이상이면 비율 값은 y = 1 에서부터 그려집니다. 패널 ``i`` 는 ``results/panels/Pnn_<name>/`` 로 저장되며 ``<Pnn_name>.pdf/.png``, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` 및 ``stats_descriptive.csv`` 를 포함합니다. 검정은 패널마다 선택됩니다(일원 ANOVA + Tukey HSD, Welch ANOVA + Games-Howell 또는 Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn 검정). :mod:`spacr.assay_panels` 를 참조하십시오.

records.context: ``replicate_column`` — column holding the biological replicate (for example ``'pathogen'`` when replicates were annotated in that slot). records.source: ``replicate_column`` — column holding the biological replicate (for example ``'pathogen'`` when replicates were annotated in that slot). The statistical unit is then the replicate mean of well means; otherwise it is the well mean. Default None.

records.translation: ``confounder_filter`` — 객체 수준의 ``{column: [min, max]}``, 또는 ``{column: {'quantiles': [lo, hi] | 'range': [min, max], 'level': 'object' | 'well'}}``. 웰 수준은 평균이 범위를 벗어난 웰 전체를 제외하며, 분위수 범위는 플레이트별로 계산됩니다. 웰 밀도 열 ``n_cells_well``, ``n_pathogens_well`` 및 ``pathogens_per_cell_well`` 은 이름이 지정되면 ``measurements.db`` 에서 가져와 추가됩니다.

records.context: ``panels`` — list of key-value mappings ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group', 'order', 'labels', 'annotations', 'reference' (default the first group in the order), 'title', 'n_resamples'}``. Each entry gives three panels: the bins (parasites per vacuole, or size-proxy volume bins) stacked as mean ± SD of replicate (or well) fractions with a chi-square test, the same with the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo, Fisher exact test for 2 x 2), each with stars for every group against the reference (Holm), and a bar panel of the replicate mean of the per-vacuole value (mean parasites per vacuole, or mean vacuole area) with the test chosen as in :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`. Written to ``<src>/results/analyze_replication/panels/Pnn_<name>_.../`` with PDF, PNG, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` (stacked) or the assumption, post hoc and descriptive tables (bar).
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#17
records.source: ``panels`` — list of dicts ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group', 'order', 'labels', 'annotations', 'reference' (default the first group in the order), 'title', 'n_resamples'}``. Each entry gives three panels: the bins (parasites per vacuole, or size-proxy volume bins) stacked as mean ± SD of replicate (or well) fractions with a chi-square test, the same with the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo, Fisher exact test for 2 x 2), each with stars for every group against the reference (Holm), and a bar panel of the replicate mean of the per-vacuole value (mean parasites per vacuole, or mean vacuole area) with the test chosen as in :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`. Written to ``<src>/results/analyze_replication/panels/Pnn_<name>_.../`` with PDF, PNG, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` (stacked) or the assumption, post hoc and descriptive tables (bar).
records.translation: ``panels`` — 사전 목록 ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group', 'order', 'labels', 'annotations', 'reference' (default the first group in the order), 'title', 'n_resamples'}``. 각 항목은 세 개의 패널을 만듭니다. 반복(또는 웰) 비율의 평균 ± SD 로 누적한 구간(액포당 기생충 수 또는 크기 대리 지표 부피 구간)에 카이제곱 검정을 적용한 패널, 같은 구성에 Fisher-Freeman-Halton 정확 검정(Monte Carlo, 2 x 2 에는 Fisher 정확 검정)을 적용한 패널(두 패널 모두 기준 대비 모든 그룹에 별표 표시, Holm), 그리고 액포별 값(액포당 평균 기생충 수 또는 평균 액포 면적)의 반복 평균을 나타내는 막대 패널이며, 막대 패널의 검정은 :mod:`spacr.assay_panels` 에서와 같이 선택됩니다. ``<src>/results/analyze_replication/panels/Pnn_<name>_.../`` 에 PDF, PNG, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` (누적) 또는 가정, 사후 검정 및 기술 통계 표(막대)와 함께 기록됩니다.
